prompt: Get the latest patient from mSupply, set its dateOfBirth to today's date, and upload it as a patient to LAMISPlus EMR.
workflow_yaml:
name: dry-run
jobs:
  fetch:
    name: Fetch record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-msupply@latest'
    body: |
      query(`query { patients(storeId: "store-a", page: { first: 1 }, sort: { key: createdDatetime, desc: true }) { ... on PatientConnector { nodes { id firstName lastName gender dateOfBirth } } } }`);
  post:
    name: Post record
    adaptor: '@openfn/language-lamisplus@latest'
    body: |
      http.post('/plugin/ehr/api/v1/patient', state => {
        const p = state.data.patients.nodes[0];
        return { firstName: p.firstName, surname: p.lastName, sex: p.gender, dateOfBirth: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) };
      });
triggers:
  webhook:
    type: webhook
edges:
  webhook->fetch:
    source_trigger: webhook
    target_job: fetch
  fetch->post:
    source_job: fetch
    target_job: post
    condition_type: on_job_success
